description: This file defines the `HabitService` class which provides methods for CRUD operations (get, add, delete) for habits against a FastAPI backend. It interacts with an `ApiClient` for HTTP requests and uses a `Habit` model for data representation.

classes.name: HabitService
classes.description: A service class providing methods to perform CRUD operations on habits against a backend API.

methods.name: getHabits
methods.description: Fetches a list of habits from the backend API.

methods.name: addHabit
methods.description: Adds a new habit with specified name and optional frequency.

methods.name: deleteHabit
methods.description: Deletes a habit specified by its ID.
